title: 第一卷 第11章 我砍价，我付款，我劳动
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傍晚六点，节目组准时开始直播。

三组嘉宾分别前往不同地点。

顾南舟和林栀去浪漫餐厅。

周闻野和姜眠去露天电影。

宋尔尔和陆执去夜市。

出发前，工作人员递给宋尔尔一张任务卡。

宋尔尔接过来，念出声：“请两位在夜市完成三项任务。第一，互相为对方挑选一种食物；第二，完成一次情侣互动小游戏；第三，用一百元完成整晚消费。”

她念完，抬头看工作人员。

“你们节目组对一百元有什么执念吗？”

工作人员低头不敢笑。

陆执站在旁边，问：“觉得少？”

宋尔尔：“不是少，是太具体。”

陆执：“具体不好？”

宋尔尔：“具体说明节目组算过，刚好够我们活着回来，但不够我们快乐。”

陆执看着她：“那今晚目标是什么？”

宋尔尔把任务卡叠好，放进口袋。

“活着回来，顺便快乐。”

弹幕刚开播就热闹起来。

【来了来了！我的下班搭子来了！】

【别人约会，宋尔尔求生。】

【一百元夜市约会，节目组你是真的抠。】

【陆执今天衣服好休闲啊，像真的陪女朋友逛夜市。】

【前面的大胆点，像陪老板娘进货。】

夜市离别墅不远。

节目组安排了一辆车送他们过去。

车上，摄像机固定在前排。

宋尔尔坐在后座左边，陆执坐右边。

中间隔着半臂距离。

工作人员问：“两位对今晚的约会有什么期待吗？”

宋尔尔：“有。”

工作人员立刻精神了：“尔尔老师期待什么？”

宋尔尔：“期待节目组不要临时涨价。”

工作人员：“……”

陆执偏头看她：“夜市摊主涨价不归节目组管。”

宋尔尔：“你不懂。”

陆执：“嗯？”

宋尔尔：“恋综里只要有任务，任何物价上涨都像剧情安排。”

陆执：“那你打算怎么办？”

宋尔尔：“砍价。”

陆执：“你会？”

宋尔尔看他一眼：“陆老师，你这句话很伤人。”

陆执：“抱歉。”

宋尔尔：“我不接受口头道歉。”

陆执：“那接受什么？”

宋尔尔：“一会儿第一串烤鱿鱼归我。”

陆执：“成交。”

司机师傅憋笑憋得肩膀都在抖。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At six o'clock in the evening, the program team started live broadcast on time.

The three groups of guests went to different locations.

Gu Nanzhou and Lin Zhi went to a romantic restaurant.

Zhou Wenye and Jiang Mian went to an outdoor movie.

Song Er'er and Lu Zhi went to the night market.

Before departure, the staff handed Song Er'er a task card.

Song Er'er took it and read aloud: "Please complete three tasks at the night market. First, choose a kind of food for each other; second, complete a couple interactive game; third, spend one hundred yuan to complete the entire night's consumption."

After she finished reading, she looked up at the staff.

"Does your program team have any obsession with one hundred dollars?"

The staff lowered their heads and did not dare to smile.

Lu Zhi stood nearby and asked, "Do you think it's less?"

Song Er'er: "It's not too little, it's too specific."

Lu Zhi: "Not specifically?"

Song Er'er: "Specify that the program team has calculated that it is just enough for us to come back alive, but not enough for us to be happy."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "Then what is the goal tonight?"

Song Er'er folded the task cards and put them in his pocket.

"Come back alive and be happy by the way."

The barrage became lively as soon as it started airing.

【Coming, coming!My date from get off work is here!】

[On a date with someone else, Song Er'er will survive.】

[One hundred yuan night market date, you are really stingy in this show.】

[Lu Zhi’s clothes are so casual today, as if he was really going to the night market with his girlfriend.】

[Be bold in the front, like accompanying the boss lady to purchase goods.】

The night market is not far from the villa.

The program team arranged a car to take them there.

In the car, the camera is fixed in the front seat.

Song Er'er sat on the left side of the back seat, and Lu Zhi sat on the right.

Half an arm's length apart.

The staff asked: "What do you two expect from tonight's date?"

Song Er'er: "Yes."

The staff immediately became energetic: "What do you expect, Teacher Er'er?"

Song Er'er: "I hope the program team will not temporarily increase the price."

Staff: "..."

Lu Zhi tilted his head to look at her: "The night market stall owners' price increases are not under the control of the program team."

Song Er'er: "You don't understand."

Lu Zhi: "Huh?"

Song Er'er: "As long as there are tasks in the drama, any increase in prices will be like a plot arrangement."

Lu Zhi: "Then what are you going to do?"

Song Er'er: "Have a bargain."

Lu Zhi: "You know how?"

Song Er'er glanced at him: "Teacher Lu, your words are very hurtful."

Lu Zhi: "Sorry."

Song Er'er: "I do not accept a verbal apology."

Lu Zhi: "Then what do you accept?"

Song Er'er: "The first skewer of grilled squid will be mine later."

Lu Zhi: "Deal."

The driver was suppressing laughter so hard that his shoulders were shaking.
